extraction.notes: The official homepage links to Summer Camps, but the supplied registration-portal text contains only the Kingsport location selector, not camp listings. No cards were created because current program names, formats and activities could not be verified. The homepage mentions Johnson City, but the supplied portal lists only Kingsport; confirm current camp locations with the provider. The gym-news.html and gym-info.html pages also returned no readable content.
